title: Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering Explained
summary: Rune Skovbo Johansen explains Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering, a technique he invented and released as open source. It makes dithering stick to 3D surfaces and covers the experiments and shortcomings along the way, inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn.
why: HN recommends it as the original explainer for a clever dithering technique and the go-to video in dithering threads.

quote.text: a 4-days old video related to dithering which is really worth watching.
